chapter: The 1920s road: dance style and management
title: Already recognized as an innovator
summary: He says the Pathe, Pantages and Orpheum dates showed he was already recognized and was reaching for greater heights.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Being honored: NEA Jazz Masters and other awards

blocks.x: Well, I take it you were also at this particular time developing your dancing further -- as a dancer rather than as a singer. Or perhaps you were doing both.
I'm still working on doing better things for the act. Still working on it, always working on something for the act.
But I'm sure you were beginning to be noticed as an innovative dancer.
Oh, yeah, we passed that point. That's how I got to Pathe' studio. That's how I go on the Pantages circuit, that's how I go on the Orpheum circuit. All these circuits and things I'd been in has

already reached that point, a pinnacle. I reached that point. So I don't have to be worried about being recognized at what I'm doing because I'm already recognized. I'm trying to get to greater heights now.
